subject: Axios Pro Rata: Beef bucks

Axios Pro Rata
By Dan Primack · Aug 26, 2026

🚨 Situational awareness: PCE, the Fed's preferred gauge for inflation, was hotter than expected for July. This comes just two days before Fed chair Kevin Warsh is set to make his first Jackson Hole speech.
 
 
Top of the Morning
 

Illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios
 

Breedr, a startup that's developed a digital system of record for cattle, today announced $27 million in new venture funding.

Why it matters: The price of beef is just too damn high, causing pain for ranchers, consumers, and politicians.

  • Breedr isn't a price control platform, per se, but could lower costs by reducing uncertainty around cattle quality.

The big picture: Austin-based Breedr is the brainchild of Ian Wheal, who was raised on an Australian cattle farm by his rancher father.

  • "The big change is moving from group-level information, which is what a lot of the old systems did, to individual animal tracking," Wheal explains. "Our iPad app links to things like weigh scales and tissue samples, which then links to individual performance so that producers can make decisions on both genetics and genomics. ... We help track from embryo to carcass."
  • He adds that "a good animal earns you $600 to $1,000 more than a bad animal."

Deal details: Partech led the Series B round, joined by insiders LocalGlobe and Outsiders Fund.

  • Proceeds will be used, in part, to expand into the Australian and New Zealand markets. Some also will go toward recruiting more U.S. ranches, particularly those undergoing generational change.

Zoom in: Breedr currently has over 2.5 million cattle and over 2,000 global ranchers on its platform. It also has a cattle marketing group with nearly $500 million of trading on an annualized basis — which could help provide more consistent supply for meatpackers — and a financing fund for ranchers (i.e. Breedr owns some animals).

Zoom out: America's cattle herd is at its lowest level in more than half a century, in part due to drought, and calf crop projections remain historically small.

  • All of that has kept beef prices very high, prompting President Trump last week to announce plans to import discounted beef without tariffs — a move that's angered ranchers and even some GOP allies.
  • Wheal says that the White House move doesn't really impact Breedr's business, as it's more focused on premium cuts whereas what Trump announced was on lower-priced ground beef.

The bottom line: Farms are getting digitized.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Aïda Amer/Axios
 

Meta (Nasdaq: META) this morning reached a sweeping settlement with a group of nearly 30 state attorneys general, to resolve a landmark child safety case.

Why it's the BFD: This is tech's version of the tobacco settlement, and could reshape the economics of both social media and AI companies.

The bottom line: Meta's capitulation will cost $11.7 billion upfront, plus around $5 billion more if social media rivals reach similar deals and change how they market to children.
 
 
Venture Capital Deals
 

• Dogotix, a robotics subsidiary of listed Chinese EV maker Xpeng, raised $900m at a $3b valuation from investors like Alibaba and IDG Capital. axios.link/46sa8ck

• Kalshi disclosed via an SEC filing that it added around $120m to a Series F round that originally closed on $1b at a $22b valuation back in April. The prediction market platform also is in market with a Series G offering.

🏀 Unrivaled, a 3-on-3 women's basketball league, raised $106m in Series C funding at a $650m post-money valuation. UC Regents-backed Ten Pillars Sports Fund led, joined by insider Bessemer Venture Partners and a large group of individual investors. axios.link/4gkBUO0

• Gatik, a developer of self-driving box trucks, raised $200m. QIA and Koch Disruptive Technologies led, joined by Millennium Management, ARK Invest, and Intact Private Capital. axios.link/4qAAHph

• Stability AI, an LA-based developer of audio models, raised $75m in Series B funding from Universal Music Group, Sony Music Group, Warner Music Group, Electronic Arts, AMD Ventures, Pacific Alliance Ventures, Coatue, Greycroft, Eric Schmidt, and Sean Parker. axios.link/45MBWrO

• Helcim, a Canadian payment processing startup, raised C$53m in Series C funding. BDC Capital led, joined by Curql Collective, Gold House Ventures and insiders Headline, Aquiline, Information Venture Partners, Vesey Ventures, Clocktower Ventures, and Alberta Accelerate Fund. axios.link/4wLzooE

• Liner, an AI search engine, raised $36.1m in Series C funding from LB Investment, InterVest, Atinum Investment, CJ Investment, KB Securities, Korea Development Bank, Daishin Securities, STIC Ventures, and Helios Private Equity. axios.link/4gjV3j7

• Celera Semiconductor, a Santa Clara, Calif.-based analog chip developer, raised a $30m Series B from Maverick Silicon. axios.link/4xmlzOE

• Runable, an Indian developer of AI agents for building businesses, raised $21m in Series A funding. Susquehanna Venture Capital and Nexus Venture Partners led, joined by insiders Together Fund and Array VC. axios.link/3SBgEdw

• Agentrys, an agentic chip design startup, disclosed $19.1m in seed funding led by Etna Labs and $5.4m of pre-seed funding led by MediaTek, per Axios Pro. axios.link/4c8VtWZ

🚑 Onos Health, an SF-based clinical intelligence startup, raised $17m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro. Costanoa led, joined by Flare Capital Partners and CVS Health Ventures. axios.link/4xlTE1z

• Hivemind, a New York-based tokenization infrastructure company, raised $17m. M&G Investments led, joined by CPIC Investment Management, ZA Bank, FalconX, and Sonic Boom Ventures. axios.link/4xWw62X

• Primero, a Mexico City-based AI transformation company, raised $12m in seed funding led by General Catalyst and Kaszek, with participation from Definition, Conviction, and 8VC. axios.link/4wWcZoV

• Newcode, a Norwegian AI orchestration platform for law firms, raised €11m in Series A funding. OnDean Forward led, joined by The LegalTech Fund, Antiportfolio Ventures, and Rel Labs. axios.link/4gxxouj

• Dolce Glow, a self-tanning product brand, raised $11m in Series A funding led by Cavu Consumer Partners. axios.link/4wJxGnT

⚡ Certain Energy, a U.K. long-duration energy storage startup, raised £10m in Series A funding. British Business Bank led, joined by Centrica, Ceres Power Holdings, and Temasek Trust. axios.link/4hPsIlQ

• Ringg, an Indian voice AI startup, raised $10m in Series A extension funding from Peak XV Partners. axios.link/3UgEtbf

• Mara, an automated counter-swarm platform targeting small drones, raised $7m in pre-seed funding. Khosla Ventures led, joined by a16z Speedrun, Night Capital, Palmdrive, Protagonist, Freedom Fund, and Indicator Fund. mara.inc

🚑 OmicsBank, an SF-based clinical data infrastructure company, raised $2.3m in seed funding from Redesign Health. axios.link/4cZwiX6

Why boardrooms are prioritizing dealmaking despite market anxiety
 
 

Global M&A volumes are up 48% against an unusually supportive backdrop of strong equity markets and a stabilized regulatory environment.

As a result, a volatility paradox has emerged: the risk of standing still has in some cases been greater than pursuing new deals.

Read the 2H 2026 Global M&A Outlook.

Public Offerings
 

⚡ Eavor, a Canadian geothermal developer backed by over US$700m in VC and project financing, hired Morgan Stanley to explore going public, per Axios Pro. axios.link/4gRyna2

• Haymaker Acquisition V, a SPAC led by Christopher Bradley (Mistral Equity), filed for a $250m IPO. axios.link/4hUvpm5
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

Illustration: Lindsey Bailey/Axios
 

• Vanguard Group has agreed to acquire Altruist, a Culver City, Calif.-based provider of software for RIAs. No terms were disclosed, but Axios has learned the price was $4.6 billion in cash.

  • Altruist had raised over $600 million in VC funding, most recently at a $1.9 billion post-money valuation in early 2025.
  • Backers include Insight Partners, Iconiq Growth, Venrock, GIC, Salesforce Ventures, Geodesic Capital, Declaration Partners, Baillie Gifford, and the Carson Family Office.

• Gamma, a presentation tool valued by VCs at $2b, acquired Lica, a design startup seeded by Accel. axios.link/4y1t7pV

⚡ Silver Hill Energy Partners is in talks to sell Haynesville Shale assets to Gunvor for over $1b, per Reuters. axios.link/4cWG1gP

• Victory Capital (Nasdaq: VCTR) has agreed to buy New York-based asset manager First Eagle Investments from Genstar Capital for around $7b in stock. Genstar, which bought First Eagle just a year ago, will hold a 14.6% stake in Victory. axios.link/3SRdLWh
 
 
More M&A
 

⚡ Siemens Energy said it plans to spin off its Transformation of Industry unit. axios.link/4qWKiHf

The impact: dealmaking is accelerating as companies race to secure supply chains and meet growing demand.
